name: Crucible Capital
identity_check: Identified as cruciblecap.xyz, the Meltem Demirors firm launched in 2024 (Fortune); its portfolio page lists Ornn, Supra, Spectral Compute and Mira Network, and Pulse 2.0 names Crucible Capital as an existing Ornn backer. Fortune calls it Delaware-based and reports two funds of $30M and $45M being raised, so the lead's '$55M, NYC' is not confirmed. Not Crucible Ventures (named in an earlier Ornn release), not Crux Capital (Dallas), not Crucible Capital Group (Preqin).
